value.rationale: The first ecology-relevant symmetry-breaking phase of homogeneous competition on odd cyclic interaction networks is a natural unresolved structural motif question after the published path thresholds. The exact parameter interval and all-size classification identify the number and layout of persistent communities and the simultaneous loss of two species with increased biomass, enabling comparison with perturbative ring and assembly models. This is not an arbitrary single-size census or merely a routine eigenvalue threshold.
